selection_basis: Metadata only: lowest-numbered group of six target channels matching Mission1 subsystem_5 and physical_unit_4 labels (group14). These anonymized labels do not prove physical equivalence.
mapping: Ascending channel number to the six frozen Mission1 network slots; no label-driven permutation
model: Frozen models/esa_contextual/context_nn.joblib; frozen entry and lifecycle thresholds
primary: Frozen weights, input normalization, scales and thresholds. No Mission2 fitting.
secondary: Same model/thresholds, only six global signal scales estimated from first 365 days without using annotation labels
evaluation: After first 365 days through final common minute of selected channels; both variants on same full scorable coverage
restrictions: No retuning or model promotion based on Mission2 results. Cross-mission transfer stress test, not proof of physical subsystem identity or operational readiness. Missingness and annotated communication gaps excluded from evaluation; labels never enter feature calculation.
